work.summary: Developed a efficient deep-learning based solution to enhance both 10-m and 20-m Sentinel-2 bands to 5-m resolution using a single deep learning framework

publications.name: SenGLEAN: An End-to-End Deep Learning Approach for Super-Resolution of Sentinel-2 Multi-Resolution Multispectral Images
publications.publisher: IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing
publications.summary: This paper proposes a deep learning model that provides an efficient solution to enhance both 10-m and 20-m Sentinel-2 bands to 5-m resolution using a single deep learning framework, facilitating precise image analysis and geoscience applications.

projects.name: Quantum Computing
projects.summary: Quantum computing is the use of quantum-mechanical phenomena such as superposition and entanglement to perform computation. Computers that perform quantum computations are known as quantum computers.
